title: Terms of Sale: Cancelling an Unfulfilled Order (Northgate Purchases & Returns)
content:
Under Northgate Purchases & Returns, member services cancels an order only on a channel where cancellation is allowed, and only while the order has not been fulfilled.

## Clause 1 — Cutoff

A not-yet-fulfilled order is cancelled only when the member asks no later than the channel's cancellation cutoff days, counted in calendar days after the order date, on channels whose cutoff is not zero. Days are counted as calendar days, the order date being day 0; the last day of the cutoff counts (a request on that day is in time). The basis is the order date on the system record of that order. A channel whose cutoff is zero can be cancelled at any time before fulfillment.

## Clause 2 — After the cutoff

After the cutoff the order is delivered, and the member may return it under the return terms, where a Northgate Special Order's restocking and pickup fees apply.

## Clause 3 — What a cancellation refunds

A cancellation refunds every sale line in full, with return reason order cancelled, at the sale unit price, together with every fee charged on the order, each fee by its own fee refund entry. A cancellation is never partial: removing some lines from an unfulfilled order is not offered. The cancelled order takes status cancelled.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Channel cutoff | Order date (day 0) | Request made on | In time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 days | 10 March | 12 March (day 2) | yes |
| 2 days | 10 March | 13 March (day 3) | no |
| 1 day | 31 May | 1 June (day 1) | yes |
| 1 day | 31 May | 2 June (day 2) | no |
| 0 (cancellable until fulfilled) | 1 April | 20 April, order still not fulfilled | yes |

## Questions answered by these terms

- *Can the member drop one item and keep the rest of an unfulfilled order?* No; a cancellation always covers the whole order.
- *Is the delivery fee kept when an order is cancelled?* No; every fee charged on the order is refunded, each by its own fee refund entry.
- *Can an order already fulfilled be cancelled?* No; cancellation applies only while the order has not been fulfilled.
